import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders for event details. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {event_title}
{event_title}
Date: {event_date}
{event_description}
{additional_notes_section}
""" def create_event_invitation(e_title: str, e_description: str, e_date: str, e_notes: str) -> str: """ Generate a secure HTML invitation for an event. Parameters ---------- e_title : str The title of the event. e_description : str A detailed description, possibly multiline. e_date : str The date of the event. e_notes : str Optional extra information or instructions. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML string representing the invitation. """ # Escape all user-supplied content to prevent injection attacks safe_title = html.escape(e_title, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(e_description, quote=True) safe_date = html.escape(e_date, quote=True) safe_notes = html.escape(e_notes, quote=True) # Conditionally include the notes section only if notes are provided additional_notes_section = ( f'
Additional Notes:
{safe_notes}
' if safe_notes.strip() else '' ) # Render the final HTML using the sanitized values invitation_html = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=safe_title, event_date=safe_date, event_description=safe_description, additional_notes_section=additional_notes_section ) return invitation_html
